rationale: Eye-level from mid-room left of the door axis: door near center, left wall enters the left edge, right wall recedes at right, ceiling band top and floor foreground like the reference.
Eye-level facing the bed wall (+z) from near the door wall: far wall symmetric in frame, ceiling band top, floor strip bottom.
Low camera looking steeply up at the door-wall ceiling corner: ceiling dominates, door wall and leaf drop into the lower-right frame.
In the doorway plane on the door axis at eye level, angled toward the far corner: doorway viewpoint with the room opening beyond (casing-edge framing not achieved, see doc).
Mid-room below-ceiling camera tilted steeply up toward the door-wall ceiling junction: ceiling fills the frame, door head at the bottom edge.
Near-floor camera aimed level-to-down at the door wall left of the leaf: floor fills the foreground, leaf lands right of center, ceiling strip on top.
